title: Reuters story quoting Flavio Estrada that the mummies are dolls

tellings.quote: In early 2024, Reuters published this about the Nazca mummies. They're not extraterrestrials, they're dolls made from animal bones from this planet joined together with modern synthetic glue, said Flavio Estrada.

plain: The Nazca mummies are small three-fingered bodies from Peru that some people present as non-human. In early 2024 Reuters reported that they are "not extraterrestrials" but "dolls made from animal bones from this planet joined together with modern synthetic glue," quoting a man named Flavio Estrada. Michels reads this out himself from the Reuters article while looking at the case.
